subject: general
question: Which of the following is not a part of the gear changing mechanism in an automatic transmission system?
solution:
The correct answer is __Universal coupling**(Option 2)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Torque converter__ is an essential part of automatic transmission systems.
 
• __Fluid coupling__ is used to transfer rotational energy between shafts in automatic transmissions.
 
• __Epicyclic gear arrangement__ is utilized to provide different gear ratios in automatic transmissions.
 
• __Universal coupling__ is not a part of the gear-changing mechanism in automatic transmission systems.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Torque Converter:**

 
 
• It is a type of fluid coupling used to transfer rotating power from an engine to a rotating driven load.
 
• It replaces the mechanical clutch in an automatic transmission system.
 
 
 
• **Fluid Coupling:**
 
 
• Fluid coupling works on the principles of hydrodynamic energy transfer.
 
• It is used in automotive applications to transmit power smoothly.
 
 
 
• **Epicyclic Gear Arrangement:**
 
 
• This gear system consists of planet gears revolving around a central sun gear.
 
• It is used to create varying gear ratios in automatic transmissions.
